test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The staff member __could not show off__ that day to the office as his ward was ill.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined phrase is "could not show off".
 
• Here, the phrase incorrectly uses "show off" which is typically used to denote bragging or displaying something proudly.</li&
